sloka: पराक्रमज्ञो रामस्य शठो दृष्ट भयः पुरा ।समुत्क्रांतः ततः मुक्तः तौ उभौ राक्षसौ हतौ ॥३-३९-१३॥
transliteration: parākramajño rāmasya śaṭho dṛṣṭa bhayaḥ purā ।samutkrāṁtaḥ tataḥ muktaḥ tau ubhau rākṣasau hatau ॥3-39-13॥

translations.english: With my escape from Rama's darts I somehow got a fresh lease of life. Now I am composed. I have started living the life of a recluse here. I have turned an ascetic.
